subject: See a plot in a sliding window

messages.author: 3c105835aeca9e15
messages.subject: See a plot in a sliding window
parts:
Hallo,
my ui is composed from two fluid rows. Each of them is composed from two squares. in the bottom right square is a heat-map. The squares above and next to will contain labels corresponding to rows or column of the heat-map. I am not able to see  whole heat-map on my screen and I don`t want to make it smaller so I must slide with the main window. If I slide with the window I sometimes do not see the labels. I would like to see my labels all the time. Is it possible to enclose the square into sliding window to see labels corresponding to rows and columns which I do see right now?
Thank you for any suggestion
Kamila

library(quantmod)

f <- function () sample(seq(1:10), 100, replace=TRUE)

in1 <- cbind (f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(),f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(),f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(),f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f(),f(), f(), f(), f(), f(), f())
label <- data.frame(L1= c(rep("A", 5), rep("B", 5), rep("C", 5), rep("D", 5), rep("E", 5)), L2=(sample(c("M", "F"), 25, replace=TRUE)), ID=seq(1,25))

label_sub <- label  


shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  labelSub <- reactive({
    label_sub <- label
    
    if (input$select_type!="all")
    {
      label_sub <- subset(label_sub, label_sub$L2==input$select_type)
    }
    
    
    if (input$select_name!="all")
    {
      label_sub <- subset(label_sub, label_sub$L1==input$select_name)
    }
    
    return(label_sub)
  })
  
  output$main_plot <- renderPlot({
    plot.new()
    # Access subsetted data via labelSub()
    IDs <- labelSub()[,3]
    par(mar=c(0, 0, 0, 0)); barplot(1:10, xaxs="i", ylim=c(0,10), space=0)
    
    for_plot <- in1[IDs,]
    if(is.matrix(for_plot)==FALSE)
    {for_plot <- t(as.matrix(for_plot))}
  
  image(for_plot)

  }, width = function () {30*nrow(labelSub())})
  
  output$lab <- renderTable({
    t(labelSub())}, include.rownames=FALSE)
  
})




shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("title panel"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
  
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("select_name", 
                     label = "name",
                     choices = c("all", "A", "B", "C", "D","E"),
                     selected = "all"),
  
   selectInput("select_type", 
              label = "Type",
             choices = c("all", "M", "F"),
            selected = "all")
    ),
  
  mainPanel(
    fluidRow(
      column(2, align="left"
      ),
      column(6, align="left", 
             helpText("A TABLE WITH INFORMATION WHICH I WANT TO SEE ALL THE TIME"),
             tableOutput("lab")
      )
    ),    
  fluidRow(
    column(2, align="left",
           helpText("A COLUMN WITH INFORMATION WHICH I WANT TO SEE ALL THE TIME")),
    column(6, align="left", 
  plotOutput("main_plot", width="auto", height=1000)
    )
  )
  )
  )
))

       div(style = "overflow-x: scroll", plotOutput("main_plot", width="auto", height=1000))
)
